Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review because the change affects posted G-code. I reviewed the trial merge with upstream main `e3f7d122b3c7fb86aff4c893667f02378fc707d8` locally.

The calculation uses the selected setup's stock and work-offset origin. The post keeps the box half-width as a lower limit. Mill streams do not receive the new parameter. No UI files change.

Local results:

| Test suite | Passed | Failed |
|---|---:|---:|
| app: lathe_post_turn_radius | 3 | 1 |
| app: lathe_post_tormach | 7 | 1 |
| app: lathe_post_tormach_g30 | 4 | 0 |
| app: lathe_post_tormach_thread | 8 | 0 |
| app: lathe_post | 7 | 0 |
| app: lathe_cycle_exit | 6 | 0 |
| app: turning_stock_approach | 3 | 0 |
| post: recorded_streams | 12 | 0 |
| post: post_engine | 33 | 0 |
| post: lathe_post_refusals | 11 | 0 |

The selected app and post test targets built with `cargo test --no-run`. Clippy passed with `-D warnings` for all post targets and for the app library and seven selected test targets.

Clippy with app `--all-targets` could not complete. Unchanged upstream code in `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:106–107` has these errors:

```text
E0308: expected Option<WorkMaterial>, found WorkMaterial
E0063: missing fields stepdown and stepover in initializer of CuttingRow
```

That file is identical to upstream main. These errors are not findings against this PR. The quick-gate plan selected the full batch because the trial merge was not committed. I ran the relevant suites directly; I did not run the full batch.

Requested changes:

1. `crates/app/tests/lathe_post_turn_radius.rs:193`: replace the fixed line window with a check that follows the G30 approach and departure motion blocks. The new test fails at line 200 because `checked` stays zero. The program contains `G30`, `T0101`, `G97 S3000 M3`, `M8`, then `G0 X19`. The window stops before that X move. The program ends with a two-axis rapid, `M9`, `M5`, then `G30`. Thus the test checks no X-only move. Keep a check that proves the test examines the intended moves.
2. `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach-lathe/axial_drill_mm.nc:19` and `axial_drill_inch.nc:19`: update the expected departure after the maintainer accepts the change. The millimetre test expects `G0 X24` but produces `G0 X33.941`. An independent inch check expects `G0 X0.9449` but produces `G0 X1.3363`. Every other line matches. These values agree with the corner diameter of the 24 × 24 stock. The stale goldens leave `an_axial_drill_posts_as_plain_moves_in_mm_and_inch` red.

I checked all nine inherited golden diffs line by line. They are already in upstream main. This PR's remaining change does not update a golden.

Two mutation checks passed:

- Ignore the turning radius in `stockEnv()`: `the_g30_moves_use_the_square_bars_corner_circle` passed before the mutation, failed with it, and passed after restoration.
- Omit the parameter from `post::dump`: `a_lathe_stream_states_the_radius_its_stock_sweeps` passed before the mutation, failed with it, and passed after restoration.

All temporary changes were restored. No GitHub runner or real control was used. The PR is mergeable, but the two test failures prevent a clean review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

- Replaced the fixed G30 line window with first and last motion-block checks between G30 calls. Both approach and departure must be examined, including a departure with X and Z words. Pinned by `a_square_bar_program_has_no_g30_rapid_inside_the_corners_circle`. Reverting the fix failed the test. Restoring it passed.
- Updated the axial-drill departure goldens to `X33.941` in millimetres and `X1.3363` in inches. Pinned by `an_axial_drill_posts_as_plain_moves_in_mm_and_inch`. Reverting each golden separately failed the test. Each restoration passed.

New head: `156dec8d689f539bfdcc01b3b39727af8d85dd02`.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: 421 post tests and 3023 app tests passed, with 22 app tests ignored. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Please re-review. The PR remains draft.

Needs changes before merge: update the PR description. The code and selected tests pass.

This is a SAFETY-tier review because the change affects posted G-code. I tested the local trial merge with upstream main `4e0b9abefcb225595d47d9c69a2482d6359b190f`.

The two findings from the previous review are resolved:

- `crates/app/tests/lathe_post_turn_radius.rs:187`: the test follows the first and last motion blocks between the G30 calls. It checks both blocks and passes.
- `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach-lathe/axial_drill_mm.nc:19` and `axial_drill_inch.nc:19`: the departure values are now `X33.941` and `X1.3363`. The millimetre and inch test passes.

The radius calculation uses the setup stock and the work-offset origin. The post keeps the box half-width as a lower limit. Mill streams do not receive the parameter. No UI files change.

Local results:

| Test suite | Passed | Failed |
|---|---:|---:|

| post: lathe_post_refusals | 11 | 0 |

The seven app test targets built with `cargo test --no-run`. The three post test targets built and ran with `cargo test`. All 96 tests passed. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

I ran the quick-gate plan with `--dry-run`. It selected 553 steps because the goldens are shared test inputs. I ran the relevant suites directly, not the full gate. The first compile stalled with sccache. I stopped it and completed validation with the compile cache disabled.

I repeated two mutation checks:

- Ignore the turning radius in `stockEnv()`: `the_g30_moves_use_the_square_bars_corner_circle` passed before the mutation, failed with it, and passed after restoration.
- Omit `StockTurnRadius` from `post::dump`: `a_lathe_stream_states_the_radius_its_stock_sweeps` passed before the mutation, failed with it, and passed after restoration.

I checked both remaining golden changes line by line against current upstream main. Each changes only the final X departure. The values agree with the rotating corner diameter of the 24 x 24 stock. The other golden changes shown by the PR are already in main.

Requested before merge:

1. PR description, “Golden question” and “How tested”, and the final issue reference: update the description for this head. It still says the two goldens are stale and the axial-drill test fails. Both statements are now false. End the body with `Fixes #1666`, as current upstream `AGENTS.md:275` requires. The current body uses `Refs #1666` and ends with a generator credit. This PR meets the issue's stated completion conditions. No code change is needed for this finding.

The PR is mergeable. I found no remaining code or test blocker. All temporary mutations were restored. No GitHub runner, GUI, or real control was used. Mill-turn posts were not exercised. The author is NeoTech, so I left the draft state unchanged.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

- Updated “Golden question” and “How tested” for the current head. The description now states the updated departures, `X33.941` mm and `X1.3363` inch, and the passing axial-drill test. It ends with `Fixes #1666`. The temporary description check rejected the old body and passed the corrected body and GitHub readback. No source change was requested or made.

Head remains `156dec8d689f539bfdcc01b3b39727af8d85dd02`. The plain push reported everything up-to-date.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: 421 post tests and 3023 app tests passed, with 22 app tests ignored. This includes `lathe_post_turn_radius` and `an_axial_drill_posts_as_plain_moves_in_mm_and_inch`. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Please re-review. The PR remains draft.
